title: N-2 ascends along a finite extension of Noetherian domains
statement: Let $A\subseteq B$ be integral domains such that $B$ is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Assume $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain]. Then $B$ is N-2: for every finite field extension $M$ [def-pc-field-extension] of the fraction field of $B$, the integral closure of $B$ in $M$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is a finitely generated $B$-module.
